basic_details.job_title: OU Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Osmania University (OU), Hyderabad, Telangana, has invited applications for the post of Research Associate (RA-I) under Advt No. OU/ANRF/PAIR/Adv/5. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

application_fee.all_applicants_fee: Rs. 100 (Demand Draft in favour of the Registrar, Osmania University, Hyderabad - 500007)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Registrar, Osmania University, Hyderabad - 500007.

age_limit.age_details: Age limit not printed; age relaxation as per ANRF/Government of India norms

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.d. in Chemical Science/Life Science; candidates with knowledge in Computational studies are preferred
qualification.details: Qualification: Ph.d. in Chemical Science/Life Science; Candidates with knowledge in Computational studies are preferred Age limit: Age limit not printed; age relaxation as per ANRF/Government of India norms Age relaxation: Age relaxation is applicable as per ANRF/Government of India norms | Desirable: | Knowledge in Computational studies

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.58,000 per month + HRA as per norms

how_to_apply: Fill in the enclosed proforma in the prescribed format.
Attach a detailed biodata and attested copies of the relevant certificates.
Attach a Demand Draft of Rs.100 drawn in favour of the Registrar, Osmania University, Hyderabad - 500007.
Send by Speed Post/Registered Post or by hand to The ANRF-PAIR Office, Department of Chemistry, University College of Science, Osmania University, Hyderabad - 500007.
The application must reach on or before 28-11-2026 at 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete or late applications will be rejected False information will lead to cancellation of candidature No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma enclosed with the advertisement (page 2)) and send it to The ANRF-PAIR Office, Department of Chemistry, University College of Science, Osmania University, Hyderabad - 500007, Telangana, India, by speed post/registered post or by hand, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.answer: Shortlisting (shortlisted candidates informed through email/phone/SMS). Interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email/phone/SMS. Original certificates must be produced at the time of interview/joining.
